message.content:
**Compounded Interest Calculation**

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Principal \(P\) | \$10 000 |
| Annual nominal rate \(r\) | 5 % → 0.05 |
| Time \(t\) | 3 years |

Using the compounding‑interest formula  
\(A = P(1+r)^t\):

\[
\begin{aligned}
A &= 10\,000 \times (1+0.05)^3\\[4pt]
&= 10\,000 \times 1.05^3\\[4pt]
&= 10\,000 \times 1.157625 \\[4pt]
&= \$11\,576.25
\end{aligned}
\]

So the **compound interest earned** over the three-year period is  

\[
I = A - P = 11\,576.25 - 10\,000 = \$576.25 .
\]

---

### Summary
- Final account balance after 3 years: **\$11 576.25**
- Total interest accrued: **\$576.25** (≈ 5.7625 % of the original principal)

If you’d like this expressed as an effective yearly yield or broken down into quarterly/montly contributions, just let me know!
